rationale: Codebase-pin lens. The row inventory is complete and every fixture's shape matches its R1.3 carve-out: all 11 rows present (spec create draft; spec approve; plan-approve TRUE three-surface agreement on plan under OQ-3 option 1; next-claim; complete's implement leg; BOTH complete->plan triggers (derive.go empty-lifecycle-subset :366-class and all-open-non-lifecycle :387-class); complete->review; both release rows two-surface AND driving the real phase.SanctionedDerivedSync from a deliberately mismatched stored value; the terminal row's two facts at two layers — done via DerivePhaseWithCache on the closed epic, idle via genuine zero-open-epic discovery in a real git root). Suite green: 12/12 agreement tests pass, full `go test -short ./...` exits 0, `go build ./...` clean, all from the bead worktree. Anti-drift probe A (in a /tmp copy): renaming a row identifier fails TestAgreementTable_DocRowsCrossPinFixtures in BOTH directions as designed. But probe B falsifies the property the spec actually promises: editing ONLY a row's mode cells — `| complete -> review (last bead) | plan | plan | plan |` in place of the three `review` cells — leaves the ENTIRE suite green. The cross-pin compares row-identifier sets only; the State show / Instruct tail / Derivation cells (the table's substantive content, and exactly where the carve-outs live — the terminal row's done-vs-idle split, the release rows' tail-less cells, spec-create's no-epic cell) are unpinned. R1.3's closing sentence ("the table cannot silently drift from code") and AC-2's closing clause ("Editing the table without the fixture (or vice versa) is red") are therefore only partially met, and the guide's own enforcement claim at lifecycle-modes.md:17-18 overstates what the test enforces. Mitigating: most row IDs embed the headline mode, so the headline claim is pinned via the ID — but the per-surface cells are not. Secondary gap: R1.3's complete->implement row explicitly includes the "remaining beads blocked" trigger (the exact condition the spec's own drafting got wrong at round 2 and re-derived at round-4 G1.1), and the guide's row note asserts "a blocked sibling counts the same way", yet no fixture in the file contains a blocked child — the claim is code-verified (derive.go counts blocked as neither closed nor in_progress, so some-closed+blocked derives implement) but test-unpinned. Both changes are small and surgical; everything else holds, so REQUEST_CHANGES, not REJECT, and no hard block.
concrete_changes_required: Extend the doc/fixture cross-pin beyond the row-identifier column: parse each data row's State show / Instruct tail / Derivation cells between the agreement-table markers and assert them against a per-row expected record (e.g. turn agreementTableRowIDs into rowID -> {stateShow, tail, derivation} entries; ideally the row fixtures draw wantMode from the same record so doc, fixture list, and code form one three-way pin). Acceptance: the probe that currently stays green — editing the complete->review row's three mode cells to `plan` in a copy of lifecycle-modes.md — must fail the suite. Tail-less/no-epic cells can be pinned as their literal sentinel text.

Pin the remaining-beads-blocked leg of the complete->implement row: add a blocked lifecycle child to TestAgreementTable_Complete_Implement_MidSpec's fixture (e.g. task("b5-3", "blocked") alongside the closed and open children) or add a second closed+blocked+open sub-assertion, so the guide note's "a blocked sibling counts the same way" claim and R1.3's explicit remaining-blocked trigger are fixture-backed against derive.go's some-closed branch.

findings.title: Anti-drift cross-pin covers row identifiers only; falsifying a row's mode cells stays green
findings.detail: TestAgreementTable_DocRowsCrossPinFixtures (agreement_table_test.go:630) parses only the first cell of each data row and compares sets against agreementTableRowIDs (:311). Empirically verified in a /tmp copy: changing the row ID `complete -> review (last bead)` to `complete -> done (last bead)` fails red in both directions (good), but changing that same row's three mode cells from `review` to `plan` — the doc now contradicts shipped code — leaves `go test -short -run TestAgreementTable ./internal/phase/` fully green. AC-2's "Editing the table without the fixture (or vice versa) is red" and R1.3's "the table cannot silently drift from code" are not met for the mode columns, and the guide's own claim (lifecycle-modes.md:13-18) that such an edit "fails TestAgreementTable_DocRowsCrossPinFixtures" is inaccurate as shipped.

findings.title: Remaining-beads-blocked trigger of the complete->implement row has no fixture
findings.detail: R1.3's row text explicitly folds "remaining beads blocked" into complete->implement (the round-4 G1.1 re-derivation correcting the round-2 error), and the guide's row-5 note claims a blocked sibling counts the same way, but TestAgreementTable_Complete_Implement_MidSpec (agreement_table_test.go:414) constructs only closed+open children and no fixture in the file contains a blocked child. Code-verified true (derive.go's some-closed branch: blocked increments lifecycleTotal but neither closed nor in_progress counters), yet the historically error-prone condition is the one leg left test-unpinned.

findings.title: Terminal row's state-show assertion includes a tautology and an any-error acceptance
findings.detail: agreement_table_test.go:598 assigns stateMode := state.ModeIdle and :609 asserts it != state.ModeIdle — the assertion can never fire. The state-show surface is still genuinely covered by the two mirrored preconditions (ResolveTargetWithCache must error at :587, drafts must be empty at :590), matching cmd/mindspec/state.go's ambient fall-through, but the :587 check accepts ANY error rather than the no-active-specs class the real code's idle branch requires (state.go returns early for ErrAmbiguousTarget and on bd-health failure). Low risk under the controlled fixture; tightening is optional.

findings.title: Observation (not this bead's defect): full -short suite dirties the bead worktree
findings.detail: Running `go test -short ./...` from the bead worktree left .beads/config.yaml rewritten (blank-line normalization + trailing-newline) and .gitignore appended (.mindspec/focus) — some test outside internal/phase invokes real bd against the repo cwd. Verified NOT caused by the agreement suite (running TestAgreementTable alone leaves the tree clean); restored via git restore, worktree left byte-identical. Flagging because `mindspec complete` auto-commits stray files; pre-existing, worth a follow-up bead, not a bead-4 change.

findings.title: Verified positives
findings.detail: All 11 R1.3 rows present with correct carve-out shapes; release rows drive the real phase.SanctionedDerivedSync from a deliberately wrong stored phase (review->implement, implement->plan) proving unconditional evidence-write; both complete->plan triggers separately fixtured and IsBackwardMove(plan,plan) asserted false (round-6 R3 discharge); terminal row asserts done via direct status-aware derivation AND idle via real-git zero-open-epic discovery; ADR-0023 strikes exactly the two :107/:108 rows by content with the amendment cross-referenced; 12/12 agreement tests pass and full `go test -short ./...` exits 0 from the bead worktree at 6f75235b.
